basic_details.post_name: Junior Research Fellow (JRF), Project Assistant (PA), and Office Staff (OS)

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Professional Courses, B.E./B.Tech., 10+2 (HS)/Diploma
qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Post Graduate Degree in Professional Courses selected through a process described through NET (CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship) or GATE, or national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments & Institute such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISER, NISER etc. Project Assistant (PA): B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering/Electronics Communication Engg./Instrumentation Engg./Applied Electronics and Instrumentation Engg./ Electrical and Computer Sc. Engg./Electrical and Control Engg./Bio-Medical Engg. with minimum 55% marks. Previous research/project work experience (if any) preferred. Office Staff (OS): 10+2 (HS)/Diploma in any stream with minimum 55 %. Candidates with previous experience preferred.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 37,000 per month consolidated

selection_process: Written test and/or interview Candidates with valid GATE/NET/Equivalent score selected through interview via offline/online mode Candidates without valid GATE/NET/Equivalent score selected through written test (offline mode) followed by interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Durgapur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Post Graduate Degree in Professional Courses selected through a process described through NET (CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship) or GATE, or national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments & Institute such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISER, NISER etc. Project Assistant (PA): B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering/Electronics Communication Engg./Instrumentation Engg./Applied Electronics and Instrumentation Engg./ Electrical and Computer Sc. Engg./Electrical and Control Engg./Bio-Medical Engg. with minimum 55% marks. Previous research/project work experience (if any) preferred. Office Staff (OS): 10+2 (HS)/Diploma in any stream with minimum 55 %. Candidates with previous experience preferred.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Durgapur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Technology Durgapur (NIT Durgapur) for a DRDO sponsored research project.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in NIT Durgapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available across Junior Research Fellow (JRF), Project Assistant (PA), and Office Staff (OS) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the names of the posts offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The posts included in this recruitment notification are Junior Research Fellow (JRF), Project Assistant (PA), and Office Staff (OS).

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 05 October 2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission before this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for NIT Durgapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly via email. Candidates need to send their bio-data and cover letter to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification required for the Office Staff (OS) post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Office Staff (OS) post must have completed 10+2 (HS) or a Diploma in any stream with a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, meaning candidates can apply without paying any fee charges.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these project-based positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a written test and/or interview. Candidates with valid GATE/NET scores may be interviewed directly, while others undergo a written test.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to check further updates?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the National Institute of Technology Durgapur at www.nitdgp.ac.in for regular updates and announcements.
